model_output.verdict: Your B2B software marketing work points toward the Tallgrass role, and your resume lists its main tools. I’d hesitate because it doesn’t show the required hands-on HubSpot work or what running campaigns involved.
write_up: Your resume tells a common marketing coordinator story: newsletters, webinars, content calendars and reporting across Brightfield Software and Keystone Benefits Group. That work is relevant to Tallgrass, but the recent bullets leave your part in the campaigns too thin to stand out in a pile.

The weekly campaign reports line is a useful model because it names the deliverable, its cadence and who received it. Your skills list also names all three tools Tallgrass asks for, but it doesn’t show which HubSpot functions you’ve used.

Let’s start with the Brightfield newsletter and webinar lines. Add the tasks that were yours and, where you can, how many people the work reached. Then connect your tools to the work you’ve done with them, especially HubSpot, if you can substantiate it.

cards.line: - Coordinated the monthly customer newsletter and product announcement emails
cards.cannot_tell: Coordinated can mean several things, from gathering content to sending the emails. A recruiter also can’t tell how many customers received the newsletter.
cards.example: Coordinated the monthly customer newsletter and product announcement emails by [your tasks], reaching [number] customers
cards.question: Which parts of the newsletter and announcement emails were yours, and how many customers received the newsletter?

cards.line: - Supported webinar planning with the product marketing team
cards.cannot_tell: Supported leaves your part of webinar planning open. Tallgrass also wants help with events, so your actual contribution matters here.
cards.example: Supported webinar planning with the product marketing team by [your planning tasks] for [webinar name]
cards.question: Which webinar did you work on, and what planning tasks did you handle?

cards.line: - Pulled weekly campaign reports for the marketing manager
cards.cannot_tell: Keep the combination of a named deliverable, a regular cadence and the person it went to. That gives the rest of your work a useful pattern to follow.

cards.line: - Helped prepare slide decks and one-pagers for the sales team
cards.cannot_tell: The sales materials are named, but helped doesn’t say what you contributed to them.
cards.example: Helped prepare slide decks and one-pagers for the sales team by [your contribution]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the slide decks and one-pagers?

cards.line: - Kept the brand asset library organized
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can’t tell what maintaining the library involved or who used it.
cards.example: Kept the brand asset library organized by [your tasks] for [who used it]
cards.question: What did you do to maintain the library, and who used it?
